coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the air conditioner on low
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a cool shower (bathroom used privately, no overlap with other members)
Making and eating breakfast with a hot drink from the kettle and toast
Changing into work clothes, packing bag and doing a short morning stretch routine
Commuting to the hospital during the morning peak on public transport (bus/train); no electric vehicle needed, so Member 2's EV remains free
Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing inpatients, delivering rehabilitation exercises and updating treatment notes
Taking a lunch break at the hospital and eating a packed meal in the cool staff room
Continuing physiotherapy sessions, running gait and mobility training and handover documentation
Commuting home after the shift on public transport (bus/train); no electric vehicle used
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker, using the range hood to keep the kitchen cool
Eating dinner and cleaning up, loading the dishwasher
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner switched off during the grid peak, using the fan and dehumidifier instead
Taking a cool evening shower and putting laundry in the washing machine (bathroom used privately)
Reviewing patient notes and reading physiotherapy articles on the computer under the desk lamp
Winding down, setting out clothes for tomorrow and sleeping with the air conditioner on low
